frames.evidence: Team handbook: review the values, record your mentor meeting, and complete the engineering intern onboarding checklist for local development access.
Team handbook: review the values, page the incident commander, and follow the incident response runbook for production service recovery.
The intern onboarding guide provisions a local development account, introduces the mentor, and schedules codebase orientation sessions.
The incident response runbook creates a status channel, captures the outage timeline, and coordinates rollback approval with operations.
Intern onboarding ends with a development environment check, a project walkthrough, and a small supervised first contribution.
Incident response ends with recovery verification, customer communication, and a scheduled blameless review of the service outage.
The onboarding document keeps the shared team handbook introduction but focuses on mentoring, local tools, and learning objectives.
The runbook keeps the shared team handbook introduction but focuses on alerts, mitigations, and production recovery decisions.
